{{Conjecture|legends}}
A small '''village''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shiffrin]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Kallin Bremen]] held the post of chief [[Constable/Legends|constable]] of the settlement, and his efforts at maintaining law and order at the village prevented it from becoming merely a lawless border [[City/Legends|town]], instead leading it to be a quite and civilized, if somewhat primitive, community.<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
